Xtra.name: Website / mortgage visit
Xtra.note: Anonymous browsing stays anonymous. Show calculator; no outbound message until details are voluntarily submitted.

Xtra.name: Loan calculation
Xtra.note: On-screen estimate. Offer “Email me my calculation” and a separate marketing consent checkbox.

Xtra.name: Application submitted
Xtra.note: Send immediate acknowledgement; calculation alone never qualifies an applicant.

Xtra.name: Assessment not approved
Xtra.note: Secure reason category, route to appeal/reapplication and optional advisory.

Xtra.name: Assessment approved
Xtra.note: Decision must come from a verified authorised review event, never browser-side logic.

Xtra.name: Customer service
Xtra.note: Assign adviser and arrange an inspection. Escalate unresponsive or unsuitable prospects to authorised alternative-property follow-up.

Xtra.name: Inspection
Xtra.note: Send booking confirmation and reminder; after completion send one useful follow-up.

Xtra.name: Offer letter
Xtra.note: Only send a secure signed/approved offer generated for a verified property and applicant.

Xtra.name: Business development
Xtra.note: A business-development specialist confirms client readiness and hands off to Finance.

Xtra.name: 30% equity payment
Xtra.note: Diagram’s 30% threshold is a proposed contractual condition, not a generic rule.

Xtra.name: Approval / readiness notice
Xtra.note: Diagram references approval within 90 days. Use a property-specific date only after verification.

Xtra.name: Key and document handover
Xtra.note: Keys, title documents and actual handover date require authorised verification.

Xtra.name: Annual 7% notice · 15 years
Xtra.note: Annual payment sequence only if a signed agreement validates rate, duration and charge basis.

Beta.name: Pre-application
Beta.note: Capture only voluntarily submitted contact details. Provide privacy notice and optional marketing consent.

Beta.name: Loan calculation
Beta.note: Calculate illustrative affordability; allow the applicant to email their estimate.

Beta.name: Application submitted
Beta.note: Immediate welcome and application reference; source diagram has success branch.

Beta.name: Application unsuccessful
Beta.note: Share secure next steps without implying an irrevocable rejection or failure to own property.

Beta.name: Application successful
Beta.note: Initial evaluation success is not full lender underwriting. Separate the two events.

Beta.name: Business development
Beta.note: Verify an account/funding route; allow contact and document requests.

Beta.name: Full qualification
Beta.note: Final decision requires authorised review, financial eligibility and contract approval.

Beta.name: 30% funding over 6 months
Beta.note: Diagram references 30% property value across six months and a 2.5% monthly-primary-income element. Legal/Finance must interpret.

Beta.name: Recurring payment confirmations
Beta.note: Send only from reconciled ledger events, not from “Pay” button clicks.

Beta.name: 90% / full-payment milestone
Beta.note: Notify on reconciled threshold and request current property-readiness estimate.

Beta.name: Property readiness within 90 days?
Beta.note: Diagram references 90-day readiness communication, not a guaranteed deadline.

Beta.name: Recurring loan status
Beta.note: Only meaningful events and consented/contractually necessary reminders; do not flood customers.

Beta.name: Overdue payment / default
Beta.note: Check reconciliation; notify, handle hardship and establish approved grace rules.

Beta.name: Breach notice
Beta.note: Never issue a legal breach notice entirely autonomously. Legal authorises final notice and service method.

Invest.name: Website sign-up / walk-in
Invest.note: Online or in-person contact is recorded only when the person actually provides information; anonymous visits are not identifiable.

Invest.name: Investment application
Invest.note: Validation, risk acknowledgement and identity checks; requested return scenarios are illustrative.

Invest.name: Sales / customer service
Invest.note: Account manager explains documents, verified investment terms and account funding steps.

Invest.name: Investment funding verified
Invest.note: Ledger reconciliation and signed documents required before receipt/breakdown.

Invest.name: Monthly project updates
Invest.note: Verified monthly investment status and breakdown (not guaranteed performance).

Invest.name: Quarterly ROI / distributions
Invest.note: Send verified quarterly statement and any distribution confirmation. Opt-in required for recommendations.

Invest.name: Opt out of marketing
Invest.note: Diagram’s opt-out branch: unsubscribe marketing, do not automatically redeem or cancel an active investment.
Invest.next: Keep mandatory service notifications if lawful

Invest.name: 90-day maturity notice
Invest.note: Advance maturity notice only where supported by the signed agreement.

Invest.name: Final payout confirmed
Invest.note: Confirmation only after settled transfer and completed ledger reconciliation.

Estate Pro.name: Website onboarding
Estate Pro.note: Prospect submits information and requests Estate Pro details.

Estate Pro.name: Welcome / onboarding instructions
Estate Pro.note: Acknowledgement and explanation of verification requirements.

Estate Pro.name: Wait 3 days
Estate Pro.note: Timer starts at confirmed onboarding. Cancel early if officer responds or the case closes.

Estate Pro.name: Assigned account officer details
Estate Pro.note: Only named, verified CRM officer details.

Estate Pro.name: Wait 24 hours
Estate Pro.note: No further contact if request is resolved, declined or suppressed.

Estate Pro.name: Did the prospect reach the officer?
Estate Pro.note: Single status check by email and WhatsApp where permission exists; escalate to live account officer if needed.

Develop.name: Website sign-up / walk-in
Develop.note: Lead from online form or consented walk-in record.

Develop.name: Customer Service welcome
Develop.note: Send client-specific onboarding and initiate property conversation.

Develop.name: Inspection confirmation
Develop.note: Send verified inspection details and book assigned staff.

Develop.name: Reminder 6 hours before
Develop.note: Only for active appointments; skip cancelled or rescheduled bookings.

Develop.name: Inspection missed
Develop.note: Record actual no-show and offer rescheduling.

Develop.name: Sales assessment
Develop.note: Separate interested client from prospect needing different options.

Develop.name: Prospect alternatives
Develop.note: Real inventory, approved incentives and permission-based remarketing.

Develop.name: Offer letter issued
Develop.note: Approved terms before payment; secure signature and documents.

Develop.name: Finance: initial payment
Develop.note: Choose outright or instalment according to signed agreement and actual ledger.

Develop.name: Instalment schedule
Develop.note: Daily/weekly/monthly reminders only for the actual contractual schedule.

Develop.name: Overdue / default
Develop.note: Reconciliation check, approved grace period, escalation to authorised Legal if needed.

Develop.name: Legal: contract of sale
Develop.note: Contract prepared and reviewed before customer signature.

Develop.name: Deed / survey / plan ready
Develop.note: Confirm which physical or digital documents actually exist.

Develop.name: Property allocation notice
Develop.note: No allocation without real verified plot/unit and authorised property records.

Dev Pro.name: Website onboarding
Dev Pro.note: Prospect enters the Dev Pro journey and voluntarily shares verified contact details.

Dev Pro.name: Welcome / onboarding instructions
Dev Pro.note: Send next-step instructions; do not imply pricing/eligibility approval.

Dev Pro.name: Wait 3 days
Dev Pro.note: SLA clock cancels when the prospect receives early staff assistance.

Dev Pro.name: Account officer details
Dev Pro.note: Publish only actual assigned officer information.

Dev Pro.name: Wait 24 hours
Dev Pro.note: Pause on reply, consent withdrawal, closed case or sales conversion.

Dev Pro.name: Contact confirmation follow-up
Dev Pro.note: Send one friendly status check; route questions to staff.

assumptions: Diagram says payment of 30% equity. Confirm basis, instalment schedule and exact project eligibility.
Source labels payment confirmation and notice of approval within 90 days. Confirm the meaning and exact SLA.
Diagram says yearly notification of 7% payment (rent) to be paid for the next 15 years. Verify legal basis and customer contracts.
Diagram describes funding of 30% of property value in six months. Verify exact schedule.
Diagram also references 2.5% monthly primary income for six months. Clarify how it interacts with the 30% obligation.
Diagram says prospect has one month after default to offset payment, after which a 5% charge arises. Confirm actual contract and regulatory suitability.
Diagram connects 90% / full payment and a 90-day readiness communication. Verify separate triggering conditions.
Uploaded welcome copy promises assessment in 10 days; confirm current SLA before any template uses it.
Historic Alacrity City figures (₦550,000) and office-address details must never be sent as universal live values.
The uploaded file is named INCUBATE.png but the diagram reads INVEST; confirm whether Invest is a distinct Landshop product or the intended Incubate journey.
Verify actual legal entity, agreed yield/distribution type, tax treatment and whether quarterly payments are promised or merely reported.
Confirm notice interval and any early exit/withdrawal provision from approved signed contracts.
Opt out from promotional communication is not automatic cancellation/redemption of invested funds.
Confirm whether timers are business days, when to cancel, and which roles own escalation.
Confirm programme eligibility, whether it differs from Estate Pro, and when a follow-up becomes intrusive.
Source depicts 6-hour reminder. Confirm cancellation/rescheduling rules and staff availability.
Only the agreed schedule for each customer; never all three cadences or uncontrolled reminders.
Diagram suggests penalties and legal escalation without a clearly verifiable universal rate/duration. Require contract-level Legal approval.
Never assert title/deed/survey availability, unit allocation or ownership solely because payment is attempted.

sourceSummary.Xtra diagram: Online → calculation → approval/failure → customer service → inspection → prospect/offer → business development → 30% equity → handover → annual 7% notices for 15 years, with call/text/email annotations.
sourceSummary.Beta diagram: Pre-application → calculation → approval/failure → business development → full qualification → funding → recurring confirmations and 90% threshold → loan issued to developer → readiness/loan updates; default/breach branch.
sourceSummary.Word document: Seven email themes: application welcome, qualification approval, inspection confirmation, offer-letter notice, instalment receipt, outright receipt, and contract-of-sale readiness.
sourceSummary.INVEST diagram (uploaded as INCUBATE.png: The graphic itself is labelled INVEST. Website signup/walk-in → investment application → sales / customer service → investment servicing → payout. Welcome / payment breakdown; monthly status; quarterly ROI notices; 90-day final payout notice; opt-out. INCUBATE is only the supplied filename, not a separately documented flow.
sourceSummary.ESTATE PRO diagram: Website onboarding → automated welcome → wait three days → prospect receives account-officer details → wait 24 hours → contact-confirmation follow-up by phone/text.
sourceSummary.DEVELOP diagram (both copies): Online signup or walk-in → Customer Service → inspection/confirmation/six-hour reminder/missed appointment → Sales → prospect alternatives or Finance → instalment/out-right payment → default or Legal → document readiness → Customer Service → allocation.
sourceSummary.DEV PRO diagram: Website onboarding → automated welcome → wait three days → account-officer contact details → wait 24 hours → follow-up by phone/text. Similar to Estate Pro but treated as separate product journey.
